arxiv-2102-12462.title: On particular examples of planar integral point sets and their classification This work was carried out at Voronezh State University and supported by the Russian Science Foundation grant 19-11-00197.
arxiv-2102-12462.creator: Avdeev N.N, Momot E.A, Zvolinskiy A.E
arxiv-2102-12462.description: Abstract Abstract. A planar integral point set is a set of non-collinear points in plane such that for any pair of the points the Euclidean distance between them is integral. We discuss the classification of planar integral point sets and provide examples of sets that are not covered by the existent classification. Keywords.

arxiv-2111-07330.title: On diagonal pluriharmonic metrics of G G -Higgs bundles
arxiv-2111-07330.creator: Natsuo Miyatake
arxiv-2111-07330.description: Abstract Let ( E , Φ ) → ( X , ω X ) (E,\Phi)\rightarrow(X,\omega_{X}) be a Higgs bundle over a compact Kähler manifold. We suppose that the holomorphic vector bundle E E decomposes into a direct sum of holomorphic line bundles.

arxiv-2112-05454.title: Localization at the quenched SU(3) phase transition
arxiv-2112-05454.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by *. It is known that the deconfining transition of QCD is accompanied by the appearance of localized eigenmodes at the low end of the Dirac spectrum. In the quenched case localization appears exactly at the critical temperature of deconfinement. In the present work, using quenched simulations exactly at the critical temperature, we show that the localization properties of low Dirac modes change abruptly between the confined and deconfined phase.

arxiv-2205-15801.title: Longitudinal single-bunch instabilities driven by coherent undulator radiation in the cavity modulator of a steady-state microbunching storage ring
arxiv-2205-15801.creator: Cheng-Ying Tsai
arxiv-2205-15801.description: Abstract Recently a mechanism of storage ring operation based on the steady-state microbunching has been proposed and investigated, which contains a laser cavity modulator providing the longitudinal focusing for the circulating microbunches. In this paper we analyze the impact of the coherent undulator radiation on the longitudinal single-bunch multi-turn collective dynamics, exploring a new possible instability mechanism.

arxiv-2206-13916.title: Grid Tariffs for Peak Demand Reduction: Is there a Price Signal Conflict with Electricity Spot Prices?
arxiv-2206-13916.creator: Sigurd Bjarghov, Matthias Hofmann
arxiv-2206-13916.description: Abstract The electricity grid is expected to require vast investments due to the decarbonization-by-electrification trend, calling for a change in grid tariff design which provides proper incentives for reducing peak loads. However, price signals from grid tariffs could be “distorted” from electricity spot prices which also represents a significant of the total consumer electricity bill.

arxiv-2303-17996.title: Definition of tolerances and corrector strengths for the orbit control of the High-Energy Booster ring of the future electron-positron collider Thanks: This work was supported by the European Union’s Horizon 2020 Research and Innovation programme under grant no. 951754 (FCCIS).
arxiv-2303-17996.creator: B. Dalena, T. Da Silva, A. Chancé, A. Ghribi 1 Paris-Saclay University and CEA Irfu, 91191 Gif-sur-Yvette, France 1 also at CNRS GANIL, 14118 Caen, France
arxiv-2303-17996.description: Abstract After the discovery of the Higgs boson at the LHC, particle physics community is exploring and proposing next accelerators, to address the remaining open questions on the underlying mechanisms and constituents of the present universe. One of the studied possibilities is FCC (Future Circular Collider), a 100-km-long collider at CERN [ 1 ] .

arxiv-2402-05210.title: Anatomically-Controllable Medical Image Generation with Segmentation-Guided Diffusion Models
arxiv-2402-05210.creator: Nicholas Konz *, Yuwen Chen, Haoyu Dong, Maciej A. Mazurowski
arxiv-2402-05210.description: Abstract Diffusion models have enabled remarkably high-quality medical image generation, yet it is challenging to enforce anatomical constraints in generated images. To this end, we propose a diffusion model-based method that supports anatomically-controllable medical image generation, by following a multi-class anatomical segmentation mask at each sampling step.

arxiv-2407-11715.title: Bidding efficiently in Simultaneous Ascending Auctions with incomplete information using Monte Carlo Tree Search and determinization
arxiv-2407-11715.creator: Alexandre Pacaud, Aurelien Bechler, Marceau Coupechoux
arxiv-2407-11715.description: Abstract For decades, Simultaneous Ascending Auction (SAA) has been the most widely used mechanism for spectrum auctions, and it has recently gained popularity for allocating 5G licenses in many countries. Despite its relatively simple rules, SAA introduces a complex strategic game with an unknown optimal bidding strategy.

arxiv-2502-02535.title: Criticality conditions in the Derrida–Retaux model with a random number of terms
arxiv-2502-02535.creator: Alexey Lotnikov, Anna Kotova
arxiv-2502-02535.description: Abstract Abstract The article considers the Derrida–Retaux model with a random number of terms, i.e. a sequence of integer random variables defined by the relations X_{n+1}=(X_{n}^{(1)}+X_{n}^{(2)}+...+X_{n}^{(N_{n})}-a)^{+} , n\geq 0 , where X_{n}^{j} are independent copies of X_{n} , the values of N_{j} are independent and identically distributed, a is a positive integer.

arxiv-2512-01825.title: Simultaneous optical and multi-band terahertz imaging using an atomic quantum sensor. Journal: opticajournal
arxiv-2512-01825.creator: Andrew Rae MacKellar*, C. Stuart Adams, Kevin J. Weatherill
arxiv-2512-01825.description: Abstract We demonstrate simultaneous imaging at 0.549 THz and 1.012 THz with an optical overlay using a two-species atomic-vapour-based technique. The atomic vapour, comprising laser-pumped rubidium and caesium atoms contained within the same cell, is used to convert two narrowband terahertz signals to optical frequencies which can then be detected using standard CMOS sensors.

arxiv-2601-09798.title: witt affine springer theory
arxiv-2601-09798.creator: Noam Nissan and Yakov Varshavsky
arxiv-2601-09798.description: Abstract . This paper extends the affine Springer theory developed by Bouthier, Kazhdan, and the second author (see [ 6 ] ) to the mixed characteristic case. In particular, we introduce a theory of perfectly placid perfect ∞ \infty -stacks and establish their dimension theory.

pmc-10574758.title: In Silico Validation of Personalized Safe Intervals for Carbohydrate Counting Errors
pmc-10574758.creator: Débora Amorim, Francisco Miranda, Carlos Abreu
pmc-10574758.description: For patients with Type 1 diabetes mellitus (T1DM), accurate carbohydrate counting (CC) is essential for successful blood glucose regulation. Unfortunately, mistakes are common and may lead to an incorrect dosage of prandial insulin. In this work, we aim to demonstrate that each person has their own limits for CC errors, which can be computed using patient-specific data.

pmc-10594125.title: Inpatient pediatric antimicrobial use for respiratory infections during the RSV surge
pmc-10594125.creator: Aaron Hunt, Rodrigo Burgos, Alfredo Mena Lora
pmc-10594125.description: Background: In the United States, pneumonia causes >100,000 pediatric hospitalizations annually. On November 4, 2022, the CDC issued a Heath Advisory concerning an upcoming surge of respiratory illnesses including SARS-CoV-2, influenza, and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV). Differentiating between viral and bacterial causes is challenging and can lead to antimicrobial overuse.

pmc-11359820.title: Safflower Yellow Injection Alleviates Myocardial Ischemia/Reperfusion Injury by Reducing Oxidative and Endoplasmic Reticulum Stress
pmc-11359820.creator: Wulin Liang, Mingqian Zhang, Jiahui Gao, Rikang Huang, Lu Cheng, Liyuan Zhang, Zhishan Huang, Zhanhong Jia, Shuofeng Zhang, Nikolaos Kadoglou
pmc-11359820.description: Safflower yellow is an extract of the famous Chinese medicine Carthamus tinctorious L, and safflower yellow injection (SYI) is widely used clinically to treat angina pectoris. However, there are few studies on the anti-myocardial ischemia/reperfusion (I/R) injury effect of SYI, and its mechanisms are unclear.

pmc-11729812.title: Artificial intelligence in clinical settings: a systematic review of its role in language translation and interpretation
pmc-11729812.creator: Ariana Genovese, Sahar Borna, Cesar A Gomez-Cabello, Syed Ali Haider, Srinivasagam Prabha, Antonio J Forte, Benjamin R Veenstra
pmc-11729812.description: BackgroundAddressing language barriers through accurate interpretation is crucial for providing quality care and establishing trust. While the ability of artificial intelligence (AI) to translate medical documentation has been studied, its role for patient-provider communication is less explored. This review evaluates AI’s effectiveness in clinical translation by assessing accuracy, usability, satisfaction, and feedback on its use.

pmc-12433493.title: Research note: Peripheral administration of Met-enkephalin: Novel attenuation of the adrenal medullary and thyroidal stress responses in young female chickens
pmc-12433493.creator: Colin G. Scanes, Krystyna Pierzchala-Koziec
pmc-12433493.description: Adrenal hormones play a critical response to stresses in poultry, livestock and other vertebrates. Moreover, there are stress effects on thyroid hormones. Plasma concentrations of epinephrine (EP), norepinephrine (NE), thyroxine (T4) and triiodothyronine (T3) were increased by restraint stress (placing pullets into a small cage in darkness) in 14-week-old pullets.

pmc-12468556.title: Three-Dimensional Sound Source Localization with Microphone Array Combining Spatial Entropy Quantification and Machine Learning Correction
pmc-12468556.creator: Guangneng Li, Feiyu Zhao, Wei Tian, Tong Yang
pmc-12468556.description: In recent years, with the popularization of intelligent scene monitoring, sound source localization (SSL) has become a major means for indoor monitoring and target positioning. However, existing sound source localization solutions are difficult to extend to multi-source and three-dimensional scenarios. To address this, this paper proposes a three-dimensional sound source localization technology based on eight microphones.

pmc-12509363.title: Healthcare providers’ perceptions of immigrant patients’ values about sexual and reproductive rights: a cross-sectional comparison with immigrants’ self-reported values
pmc-12509363.creator: Andrey Tibajev, Irina Vartanova, Pontus Strimling, Birgitta Essén
pmc-12509363.description: BackgroundStereotypes about immigrant patients in healthcare can hinder effective communication, erode trust, and contribute to discrimination and poorer health outcomes. Culturally competent healthcare aims to improve communication and build trust by acknowledging patients’ cultural backgrounds, but it also risks overemphasising cultural differences and reinforcing stereotypes.

pmc-12565497.title: Automatic Brain Tumor Segmentation in 2D Intra-Operative Ultrasound Images Using Magnetic Resonance Imaging Tumor Annotations
pmc-12565497.creator: Mathilde Gajda Faanes, Ragnhild Holden Helland, Ole Solheim, Sébastien Muller, Ingerid Reinertsen
pmc-12565497.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Automatic segmentation of brain tumors in intra-operative ultrasound (iUS) images could facilitate localization of tumor tissue during the resection surgery. The lack of large annotated datasets limits the current models performances. In this paper, we investigated the use of tumor annotations in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans, which are more accessible than annotations in iUS images, for training of deep learning models for iUS brain tumor segmentation.

pmc-12674911.title: Improving Colorectal Screening Compliance Through Targeted Quality Improvement Interventions in Primary Care
pmc-12674911.creator: Olubunmi Oladunjoye, Isabel Valdez
pmc-12674911.description: Background: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is the third most common cancer in the United States, and yet it is one of the most preventable cancers. Despite multiple available screening options, national CRC screening rates remain suboptimal. There is an observed lower participation among middle-aged adults compared with those 65 years and older.

pmc-13209837.title: Leptospira Infections in Cats—What Do We Know?
pmc-13209837.creator: Bernard Wasiński
pmc-13209837.description: The incidence of Leptospira spp. infections in cats did not seem to be of major importance until the early 21st century. The relatively rare occurrence of individuals presenting antibodies against Leptospira spp. and the almost unheard of clinical cases appeared to suggest that felids are poorly prone to Leptospira infections.

pmc-13239081.title: Reply to “Preclinical and Clinical Evidence on Chloroquine or Hydroxychloroquine in COVID‐19”: Achieving Statistical Significance Does Not Mean That Clinical Relevance Can Be Disregarded, and This Must Be Considered When Interpreting Results
pmc-13239081.creator: Inès Ben Ghezala, Marc Bardou
pmc-13239081.description: overall pharmacological and clinical evidence does not support their use as effective antivirals. First, it is correct that TMPRSS2 is not the sole viral entry pathway for SARS‐CoV‐2, but its predominance in relevant human airway cells remains well established. CQ/HCQ primarily target endosomal acidification, which relative contribution in vivo appears insufficient to translate into clinically meaningful antiviral activity.

pmc-13257751.title: Antibacterial Activity and Molecular Docking Studies of Black Cumin (Nigella sativa L.) Oil and Its Comparison with Some Antibiotics
pmc-13257751.creator: Ayşe Kanıcı Tarhane, Celal Tuğrul Zeyrek, Serdal Tarhane, Murat Sert, İbrahim Filazi, Fatih Büyük, Lütfiye Sirka, Çağlar Salduz
pmc-13257751.description: Black cumin (Nigella sativa L.) oil has been traditionally used to manage infectious diseases. The scientific validation of its antibacterial potential remains of significant pharmacological interest. This study evaluated the in vitro antibacterial activity of cold-pressed black cumin oil against selected bacterial strains and compared its efficacy with that of common β-lactam antibiotics, supplemented by mechanistic insight through molecular docking.

pmc-13337530.title: Stroke‐Mimic: An Intracranial Dural Arteriovenous Fistula Revealed by New‐Onset Seizures and Post‐Ictal Deficit
pmc-13337530.creator: Michael Van Haute, Mary Martin, Mark Harmon
pmc-13337530.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Intracranial dural arteriovenous fistulas (iDAVFs) are rare vascular malformations with diverse neurological symptoms depending on their venous drainage pattern. We describe a 59‐year‐old man who presented with transient right‐sided weakness and facial droop following new‐onset seizures. CT demonstrated asymmetric arterial‐phase enhancement of the left transverse sinus and cortical veins, while MRI revealed left occipitotemporal and cerebellar hemorrhages consistent with venous congestion. Digital subtraction angiography confirmed a high‐grade left anterior condylar iDAVF with cortical venous reflux (Borden II; Cognard IIa+b).

pmc-13399884.title: How to reduce the risk of inadvertent aortic root puncture during transseptal puncture?
pmc-13399884.creator: Jyothi Vijay, Narayanan Namboodiri
pmc-13399884.description: . The omission of this step was acknowledged but deserves greater emphasis, as it led to the chain of events that was critical. Attaching a three-way connector can facilitate pressure recording and/or contrast injection.

pmc-13422065.title: Using social media to highlight inhaled occupational exposures as a cause of lung disease
pmc-13422065.creator: David Fishwick, Sara De Matteis, Martie van Tongeren, Emma Thompson, Dick J J Heederik, Saskia Weldam, Ewelina Szmytke, Jessica Denning, Andrew David Curran, Pippa Powell

pmc-13480586.title: Management of Paediatric Acute Asthma in a Metropolitan Emergency Department: A Retrospective Audit
pmc-13480586.creator: Yasmine Toufaili, Nounu Sarukkali
pmc-13480586.description: AimTo evaluate adherence to the Sydney Children's Hospital Network (SCHN) Asthma‐Acute Management Practice Guideline in the management of paediatric patients presenting to a metropolitan emergency department (ED).MethodsA cross‐sectional retrospective audit of 153 paediatric ED presentations with acute asthma between March 2023 and February 2024 was conducted.

pmc-13560442.title: Harmonizing intervention, context, and implementation strategies with Context-Driven Co-Design (CD2)
pmc-13560442.creator: Sarah A Birken, Emily R Haines, Cheyenne R Wagi, Bonny B Morris, Kathryn E Weaver, Kathleen M Lisborg, Sara J Landes, Geoffrey M Curran, Miriam Bender, Maria E Fernandez, Ashley Strahley, Kimberly Wiseman, Kristie L Foley
pmc-13560442.description: BackgroundExtant approaches to close the gap between implementation evidence and practice have been unsuccessful due in part to overreliance on researcher engagement. In practice, change is often driven by mid-level managers. We developed Context-Driven Co-Design (CD2) to equip mid-level managers with a theory- and evidence-based approach to implementation planning.MethodsWe used a two-pronged design.

pmc-13587175.title: The kidney and IGF-1 axis as a central regulator of linear growth and adult height in pediatric health and disease
pmc-13587175.creator: Ashraf Soliman, Mostafa Elbaba, Fawzia Alyafei, Noor Hamed, Nada Alaaraj, Shayma Ahmed
pmc-13587175.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The kidney plays an important role in normal linear growth throughout childhood by regulating systemic insulin-like growth factor-1 (IGF-1) bioavailability through the filtration and processing of IGF-binding proteins and by serving as a target organ for growth hormone (GH). In pediatric chronic kidney disease (CKD), impaired renal function is associated with reduced availability of bioactive IGF-1 despite normal or modestly elevated total IGF-1 concentrations, reflecting altered binding protein dynamics and functional GH–IGF resistance.
